احتجزن (form VIII)
# اِحْتَجَزْنَ (iḥtajazna) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒaz.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# اُحْتُجِزْنَ (uḥtujizna) /uħ.tu.d͡ʒiz.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
# اِحْتَجِزْنَ (iḥtajizna) /iħ.ta.d͡ʒiz.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِحْتَجَزَ (iḥtajaza)
